title: No empty cells in the named columns
description: No cell of a named column is empty: null or blank as read, or equal to the missing marker the kept table declares for its column. Each empty cell fails; its example names its row and column, and the row's key cell when the run names a key column. A named column that is absent makes the rule not apply.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.source: Named by the run: the columns the team needs filled (E192).

parameters.name: key
parameters.source: Named by the run, or none: the column whose cell names a failing row (E192).

words.template: {count} cells in the named columns are empty, the first at {first}.
